item.title: Microsoft breach exposes administrator contacts
item.description: BleepingComputer reports attackers accessed administrator email addresses and tenant metadata through Microsoft Entra Connect Health, which monitors organisations’ on-premises identity infrastructure. Microsoft says it fixed the flaw on 19 November, requires no customer software update and found no exposure of passwords or authentication tokens, but advises vigilance for targeted phishing; the number of affected organisations remains undisclosed.
item.dc:creator: BleepingComputer

item.title: BADBOX returns after earlier disruptions
item.description: BleepingComputer, citing HUMAN’s Satori researchers, reports BADBOX 3.0 reached roughly 40 billion fraudulent advertising bid requests daily at its peak through infected Android-based devices, measuring requests rather than paid views or financial losses. Devices also joined residential proxy networks without owners’ consent; recent takedowns disrupted operations, but HUMAN warns the operators may adapt again.
item.dc:creator: BleepingComputer

item.title: Hong Kong's Passkey Mandate Is a Market Filter

item.title: Progress Software's Silent ShareFile Shutdown

item.title: THORChain Has Cleared Pyongyang's Money Twice

item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner
